The chain is internally coherent and the arithmetic for the observational marginals is correct, but it treats the rung-3 “for those who are pexu, if not pexu” question as a simple comparison of P(rukz|not pexu) vs P(rukz|pexu). For this causal structure with Kraz confounding pexu and rukz, the relevant quantity is an effect-on-the-treated/counterfactual comparison, not the observational conditional contrast.
